title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer l Azure l Databricks l Dimensional Modelling l PowerBI l £550-£570 per day | Outside IR35 | London (2 days per week) | 6 months + extensions likely

We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join a large-scale data transformation programme, helping shape the future of an enterprise data platform.

This role suits someone who combines technical leadership with hands-on delivery. You'll be comfortable challenging solution designs, influencing architecture decisions and then building the solution yourself.

Key experience required:

  • Deep expertise in dimensional modelling, semantic models and Power BI
  • Strong experience designing and building Gold-layer data solutions
  • Ability to work across engineering, analytics and reporting
  • Experience influencing technical direction and challenging design decisions
  • Enterprise-scale mindset with a focus on scalability, reuse and maintainability
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Comfortable mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across a team

We're looking for a senior engineer who can think strategically whilst staying close to the technology, owning solutions from the data platform through to the end-user reporting experience.

Contract Details

  • £550-£570 per day
  • Outside IR35
  • 6-month initial contract
  • High likelihood of extension
  • London based
  • 2 days per week onsite

If you're a Lead or Principal Data Engineer who enjoys operating at the intersection of architecture, engineering and analytics, we'd love to hear from you.
